description: Compact segmented control in the dashboard header that re-scopes the WHOLE screen between Household (default) and Me. Every tier below (status headline, hero number, this-week proof, trajectory, recent activity) recomputes for the selected scope. Hidden entirely for solo users.

designSystem.animation: active pill slides between segments with animation.fast (instant under reduce-motion)

onChange.description: (scope) => void; triggers the scoped refresh path

visible.description: Pass false / render null for solo users (householdMembers.length < 2)

behavior.soloUsers: component returns null; screen renders Me-scope data with no toggle and no partner avatars

scopeSemantics.me: current user's own transactions/budgets/bills only (tx.user_id === userId)

accessibility.touchTarget: >=44pt wide per segment via hit-slop even though visual height is 32pt

developerNotes: Thread a single scope state through all dashboard derivations. Force 'me' and return null from the toggle when householdMembers.length < 2. Changing scope reuses the same refresh path as pull-to-refresh, scoped.
